name: User dismisses bot's suggestion for training
goal: Test bot's response when user dismisses a recommended training module.
constraints: Bot should not insist, but offer alternatives or record feedback.

phases.description: Bot suggests a training module based on manager's recommendation.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot provides details about the training.

phases.description: User dismisses the suggestion (e.g., 'I don't need that.').
phases.completionCriteria: Bot accepts the feedback and offers alternatives or notes the user's preference.

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
